fusions.name: Roost Scatter
fusions.desc: Looses 4 small bats in a spread out to 6 tiles, each dealing 3 shadow damage. 15% of the damage dealt comes back to you as healing over 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Converging Swarm
fusions.desc: Sends a swarm of bats into the first enemy in its path up to 8 tiles away, dealing 28 dark damage plus 5% of its maximum health if it is a boss or elite.

fusions.name: Colony Overhead
fusions.desc: Hangs a roost of bats where you stand for 15 seconds. It strikes an enemy within 4 tiles for 4 damage every 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Thirst at the Brink
fusions.desc: When your health falls below half, you heal for 35% of the damage you deal for 6 seconds. Once every 30 seconds.
